resources.string: Time ranges within one day · one per line

Turn off all-day mode to enter separate, non-overlapping ranges on the same day, such as 09:00-10:00 and 15:00-16:00, one per line. Enter hours and minutes directly. A single range cannot cross midnight.

All-day tasks may span consecutive days. Multi-day tasks cannot repeat. Completing a repeating task completes only its current occurrence. Dates and reminders use the current device time zone and are recalculated if it changes.

Up to 2,000 tasks, 12 time ranges and 50 checklist items per task.
Check the title, dates, time ranges, repeat rule and checklist.

Pinned tasks always come first. Notes and checklists are shown by default.

System notification settings control banners, sound, lock-screen visibility and whether ongoing notifications can be dismissed. With content hidden, notifications show only counts or generic text; the system may further hide lock-screen content.

Without exact alarm access, reminders use system-permitted inexact alarms and may be delayed. Denied notification permission, force-stopping the app or manufacturer background restrictions may prevent delivery. Use a system alarm or another reliable method for important events. Check notifications, exact alarms and battery restrictions under Global settings → Permissions and system restrictions.

Reminders and the ongoing summary are controlled separately. The summary shows up to 3 titles by default. All-day tasks default to a 09:00 reminder. Notifications can complete an occurrence or snooze it for 10 minutes. Pending reminders are restored after reboot; catch-up delivery alerts at most 5 tasks per batch.
New tasks are all-day by default
Applies only to newly created tasks. Existing tasks are unchanged. New tasks are timed by default.
Task start and end reminders. Configure banners, sound and lock-screen visibility in system settings.

Tasks stay on this device and are included in full configuration transfer. Uninstalling deletes data that has not been exported. Notifications may appear on the lock screen; task content can be hidden in reminder settings.

Added tasks with multiple same-day ranges, all-day and multi-day tasks, repeat rules, category colors, priorities, checklists, search, filters and sorting.\n\nAdded reminders, notification completion and snooze actions, optional ongoing summary, notification privacy and system permission checks. Tasks are included in full configuration transfer with backward compatibility.
